memorii.detalii:
De la: Render <no-reply@render.com>
ID Gmail: 1a20f642cb974735
Thread: 1a20f642cb974735
Data: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 21:09:04 +0000
Subiect: Security notice for services using Ghostscript or ImageMagick

Conținut:
Hello,

On November 21, researchers published details of a
vulnerability in Ghostscript known as Upload2Shell
(CVE-2026-125396). This vulnerability can allow remote code
execution when Ghostscript processes a maliciously crafted
file.

What to do if you use Ghostscript

If you have a Render service that uses Ghostscript, make
sure you're running a patched version as soon as possible.
This includes services that use Ghostscript through another
tool such as ImageMagick or Pillow.

- For services on a Render native runtime, a patched
  version of Ghostscript is now bundled with the runtime.
  If your service hasn't deployed successfully since
  November 20, 2026, at 20:00 UTC, trigger a deploy from
  your service's page in the Render Dashboard.
  https://dashboard.render.com

- For services that use Docker or bundle their own copy of
  Ghostscript, update Ghostscript before redeploying.

For additional details, please see our Upload2Shell
advisory.

https://render.com/docs/advisory-upload2shell

If you have questions or need assistance, reach out to our
support team in the Render Dashboard.

https://dashboard.render.com?contact-support

Thank you,
The Render Team

You are receiving this security advisory even if you have
opted out of marketing communications.
